steps.name: environment - persist NODE_ENV and verify Node/npm runtime (idempotent)
steps.description: Validate Node.js major version meets minimal LTS requirement (>=18), verify npm, and create idempotent /etc/profile.d entries for NODE_ENV and npm global bin without expanding variables at write time so future shells evaluate them. This ensures consistent CLI behavior across sessions.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/career-navigator-23819-23868/AWSInfrastructureServices"
# Verify node and npm exist and Node major >=18
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'node not found' >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'npm not found' >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -v | sed 's/^v//' | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "node major version $NODE_MAJOR is unsupported (require >=18)" >&2; exit 3; fi
# Idempotent write of NODE_ENV (do not overwrite if identical)
NODE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
if ! sudo test -f "$NODE_FILE" || ! sudo grep -q "export NODE_ENV=development" "$NODE_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo 'export NODE_ENV=development' | sudo tee "$NODE_FILE" >/dev/null
  sudo chmod 644 "$NODE_FILE"
fi
# Idempotent write of npm-path without expanding current $PATH or npm bin -g now
NPM_PATH_FILE=/etc/profile.d/npm_path.sh
if ! sudo test -f "$NPM_PATH_FILE" || ! sudo grep -q "npm bin -g" "$NPM_PATH_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo tee "$NPM_PATH_FILE" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Ensure npm globals are on PATH at shell runtime
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_G_BIN="$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)"
  export PATH="$NPM_G_BIN:$PATH"
fi
EOF
  sudo chmod 644 "$NPM_PATH_FILE"
fi
# Verify files readable and node/npm versions accessible
sudo -k >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies - install project dependencies locally (idempotent, deterministic)
steps.description: Install react, react-dom, react-scripts, jest and dev/test helpers into the workspace non-interactively. Use npm ci when package-lock.json exists for deterministic installs. Skip if node_modules appears complete (node_modules/.bin/react-scripts present). This step uses exact versions via --save-exact to reduce flakiness.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/career-navigator-23819-23868/AWSInfrastructureServices"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# If react-scripts binary exists, assume deps present
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/react-scripts" ]; then exit 0; fi
# prefer npm ci if lockfile exists for deterministic results
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent --no-progress
else
  # install core deps with exact versions derived from published latest at install time
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --no-progress react react-dom react-scripts jest --save --save-exact
fi
# validate key binaries
if [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/react-scripts" ]; then echo 'react-scripts missing after install' >&2; exit 4; fi
if ! npm --silent --prefix "$WORKSPACE" ls jest >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'jest missing after install' >&2; exit 5; fi
exit 0

steps.name: validation - build, start dev server with env, verify HTTP content, then stop
steps.description: Build the app to validate production build, then start the CRA dev server in background with environment loaded from workspace .env (exported into the process). Poll for readiness using PORT from .env, verify HTTP status and that the returned HTML contains the app title string, then stop the server and emit the tail of logs as evidence.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/career-navigator-23819-23868/AWSInfrastructureServices"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Build to validate production build path (non-interactive)
npm run build --silent || { echo 'build failed' >&2; exit 2; }
# Source .env into this shell to obtain PORT and BROWSER
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/.env" ]; then
  set -a; source "$WORKSPACE/.env"; set +a
fi
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
: "Ensure NODE_ENV and BROWSER are set for the spawned process"
export NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-development}
export BROWSER=${BROWSER:-none}
# Start dev server in background capturing logs
LOG=/tmp/awsinfra_dev_server.log
nohup env NODE_ENV="$NODE_ENV" BROWSER="$BROWSER" PORT="$PORT" npm start --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# Wait for server to accept connections with retries (longer timeout)
TRIES=0; MAX=60
until curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" -o /tmp/awsinfra_index.html >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ $TRIES -ge $MAX ]; do sleep 1; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); done
if [ $TRIES -ge $MAX ]; then echo 'dev server did not start in time' >&2; kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true; exit 3; fi
HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/")
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "200" ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "302" ]; then echo "unexpected HTTP code: $HTTP_CODE" >&2; kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true; exit 4; fi
# Stronger evidence: check for application title or root div
if ! grep -q "AWSInfrastructureServices" /tmp/awsinfra_index.html 2>/dev/null; then echo 'expected content not found in index HTML' >&2; kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true; exit 5; fi
# Clean stop
kill "$PID" || true
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
# Evidence: print tail of server log
tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true
exit 0

output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PIDFILE=/tmp/awsinfra_dev_server.pid
LOG=/tmp/awsinfra_dev_server.log
if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "${PID:-}" ] && kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    echo "stopped pid=$PID"
    tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true
    exit 0
  else
    echo "no process to stop for pidfile $PIDFILE" >&2
    tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true
    rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "pidfile not found: $PIDFILE" >&2
  tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true
  exit 1
fi
